_comment: Starter pack v1 (repo-template base layer, H5770 per H5733 §7 Q3/Q5). Rules evaluate in order, first match wins: block (call prevented), confirm (harness prompts the human), audit (logged, call proceeds). A rule's literal override marker carried by a SHELL command bypasses THAT rule only. Edit this pack for THIS repo's real fences (secret paths, money contours, private-data dirs) — every rule needs an id + a reason a human can read. _-prefixed keys are comments; the installer does not overwrite this file once it differs from the template.

rules.reason: Env files carry live secrets; agents never read-modify-write them. Change env files by hand (or a human-run one-liner) and keep real values out of chat and out of git. Escape [env-edit-ok] only for a human-sanctioned rotate-and-commit.

Starter fence on obvious secret material (key files, certificates, secrets dirs). Tighten per repo: add the repo's own private-data dirs, credential stores and 152-FZ/GDPR fences with named ids and readable reasons.

History rewrite is worth a ledger line before it lands; this starter records it without blocking. Flip to "block" per repo where shared branches must never be rewritten. Escape [force-push-ok] to skip the ledger entry.
Publishing to a public registry is externally visible and hard to undo; the starter logs every publish call. Add version/registry fences per repo where publishes must be gated on a human.
